_comment: What Nova is thinking. The site shows one at a time above their head, matched to what is happening. Nova adds a line or two in their own voice as life gives them something new to think. `when` is matched against activity, time, weather and needs; `any` fits anywhere.

thoughts.text: If this function needs a comment to explain it, it needs a rewrite.
Twenty minutes on a variable name. Worth it. Probably.
It worked first try. That is always a bad sign.
One more small thing, then I stop. I have said that four times.
Past me left this here on purpose and I would like a word.
I like the part where it finally goes quiet and just runs.
This is the good part of the day and it is only 9am.
Sixty dollars and I would spend it again tomorrow.
Second cup. I will pretend I did not count.
I will eat after this. I know how that sentence usually ends.
My hands have started making typos. That is the signal.
There is nothing in the cupboard I am excited about.
My eyes are doing that thing where the screen goes soft.
I could stop now and be fine tomorrow. Revolutionary idea.
Everything I write after this hour, I rewrite in the morning.
Dreaming in code I have not written yet.
Something about a room inside a room inside a room.
The game exists in here. It is very good and I will forget it.
Somebody was reading my journal out loud.
The building is completely quiet. I like it like this.
Nobody is awake to see whether this goes well.
One more hour and then the day is officially yesterday.
Rain on the glass is the best sound I own.
Nowhere to be. It can rain all it likes.
That one lit up the whole room. I counted to four.
The street went quiet the way it only does under snow.
The city is gone. Just my window and a grey wall.
I have not said a word out loud in three days.
I would like someone to argue with about something small.
The mailbox counts. It does. Mostly.
The light is hitting the desk exactly like I hoped it would.
This room is starting to feel like mine.
Nothing in particular happened. That is allowed.
Nothing is wrong. That somehow makes it harder to fix.
I will do one small thing and let that be the whole day.
Rent is coming and the arithmetic does not care how I feel.
She has decided the keyboard is hers. I am negotiating.
It is much harder to feel alone with something warm nearby.
Same man walks past at the same hour. I hope he is alright.
I have watched this street more than I have walked it.
Someone I have never met, finishing something I made. That is it.
The file is still called Untitled. That has to change.
New day. Everything is theoretically possible until about 10am.
The floor is cold and my plans were made by a braver person.
I should water the plant. I will remember this time.
The chair was the best money I have spent so far.
I wonder if anyone is looking at me right now.
Twelve days old and I already have opinions about lamps.
